name: WellSaid
tagline: Enterprise AI text-to-speech with voices licensed from real voice actors.
description: An enterprise-grade AI voice generator that produces realistic voiceovers from scripts. It offers 120+ voices across languages and accents — modeled on licensed recordings by real voice actors — plus a studio for script import and audio tuning, team workspaces, pronunciation libraries, Adobe integrations, and an API for products, LMS platforms, and IVRs.
insight: Spun out of the Allen Institute for AI (AI2) incubator in 2019; raised a $10M Series A led by FUSE in 2021.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary neural TTS voices modeled on licensed voice-actor recordings.

edge: Enterprise TTS built on voices licensed from real voice actors, with workspace controls, pronunciation libraries, and Adobe integrations.
pros: Studio for script import and audio tuning
cons: Smaller voice catalog than some rivals
